'''Bakken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]], who worked as a [[Rebel privateer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Bakken joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], working as an "alien cultures consultant" for [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Alliance Sector Command]] in the [[Zaric sector/Legends|Zaric sector]]. However, after he had worked for them for a few years, he decided that he instead wanted to be a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]]. Bakken's superiors tried to dissuade him from pursuing his new career, so they reluctantly let him go. He survived two cruises and returned with some cargo, to make a contribution to the Alliance.
